findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_site_health" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_ai_crawler_access, check_email_security, check_site_health, check_social_search_preview, get_ai_ready_badge, write_review_reply · Private data: check_email_security · Public sink: check_email_security, check_site_health, write_review_reply · Destructive: get_ai_ready_badge, write_review_reply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_ai_crawler_access, check_email_security, check_site_health, check_social_search_preview, get_ai_ready_badge, write_review_reply · Private data: check_email_security · Public sink: check_email_security, check_site_health, write_review_reply · Destructive: get_ai_ready_badge, write_review_reply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
